name: t3-cr-loop
description: T3 Code-native multi-model code review convergence loops: council review (e.g. Gemini 4 Neon + Claude Opus 5.5 + GPT 6.2 Sol) on Round 1 and step-back rounds via parallel delegate_task, default single model on incremental and confirmation rounds, live model discovery via orchestrator_capabilities, persistent user config with per-invocation model/effort overrides, and three completion modes (stop, local merge, PR).

interface.shortDescription: Multi-model T3 Code review loop with council first/step-back rounds and stop/merge/PR modes.
interface.longDescription: T3 Code-native convergence review loop forked from codex-cr-loop v1.8.1. Discovers available providers and models via orchestrator_capabilities, guides first-time setup of default and multi-model council reviewers, runs parallel delegate_task council reviews on Round 1 and step-back rounds, enforces base-sourced rule gates, interaction guards, strict JSON validation, and two-clean-round convergence.
defaultPrompt: Run t3-cr-loop-pr and open a PR.
